# gifmaker-core (Python)

Python bindings for the `gifmaker_core` native library, built on `ctypes`.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9 or later
- The native library (`libgifmaker_core.so`, `libgifmaker_core.dylib`, or `gifmaker_core.dll`)

## Install

```bash
pip install .
```

## Loading the native library

The bindings load the library from `GIFMAKER_CORE_LIBRARY` when it is set (a full path),
then from inside the installed package, then from the system loader's search
path.

## Usage

```python
import gifmaker_core
```
